prerequisites: Obtain the full complement prompt on its exact English TokRepo page.
Paste one full selected SOP draft, a labelled list WITH substantive original N1-N5 excerpts, and explicit intended audience and purpose.
Do not pass labels/URLs alone or substitute a model-generated summary for the underlying process evidence.
Resolve missing or contradictory source inputs first. The source-optional introduction conflicts with its missing/too-short-source stop rule; do not promise a no-source audit.
A human must check every source assignment, apply edits and separately review imperative steps, order, roles, access, stop conditions and completion.
findings: Produces counts, a factual claim-to-source grid, risky wording, repair types and open questions.
SOURCED means purported traceability, not truth; model/source-label errors remain possible.
Does not browse/open source URLs, rewrite or apply edits. No-source operation is not a reliable promised route because of conflicting instructions.
Imperative actions may not be factual assertions. A clean claim grid cannot establish complete steps, correct ordering, permissions, operational safety or approval.
